content:
josh (support): FYI ticket from customer — they say their free-trial credits didn’t decrement after a multipart streaming session with a client retry and a subsequent rollback. session_id: sess_8765. Quote: "sent ~1200 tokens, dashboard still shows full 10k trial credits".

ana (billing): Can you paste account_id and approximate timestamps? I’ll pull the ledger.

josh (support): account_id: org_acme_42, session start 2024-08-15T22:14:03Z, end 2024-08-15T22:16:21Z. SDK v0.9.4, streaming chunk commits. Logs show client retried with idempotency_key: id_998. They think finalize wasn't persisted.

kevin (eng-runtime): Tagging in — this sounds like a finalize/commit race. Can you grab the edge request_ids and any webhook delivery results? Also need the finalize payload if you have it.

josh (support): attaching edge logs snippet below:
```json
{"ts":"2024-08-15T22:16:20Z","event":"STREAM_CHUNK","request_id":"r_abc123","seq":24,"session_id":"sess_8765"}
{"ts":"2024-08-15T22:16:20Z","event":"CLIENT_RETRY","request_id":"r_abc123_retry","idempotency_key":"id_998"}
{"ts":"2024-08-15T22:16:21Z","event":"STREAM_FINALIZE","request_id":"r_final_001","session_id":"sess_8765","tokens":1200}
```

support-bot: webhook delivery failed to customers/api/finalize 2024-08-15T22:16:22Z 504

kevin (eng-runtime): Ok suspicious: we have STREAM_FINALIZE on the edge but a 504 to the customer callback. I see a DB deadlock in our finalize path at ~22:16:21 earlier today which triggered a rollback. Need ops to pull the ledger row for sess_8765 and check commit_state.

ana (billing): I queried the ledger: row exists but commit_state=rollback and token_delta=0. ledger_id: 9999. Looks like the system rolled back and never sent a debit to accounting.

kevin (eng-runtime): Confirmed in service logs: finalize handler hit a deadlock and executed rollback. Reconcile job at 22:17:05 attempted to reconcile but skipped due to idempotency mismatch (id_998 vs id_999) created by client retry. Root cause: new idempotency key on retry prevented reconcile from matching the in-flight claim.

josh (support): Customer wants next steps and asks for credits replacement if the accounting gap is confirmed.

ana (billing): I will provisionally top up 1200 tokens pending engineering confirmation. Please provide a repro and mitigation plan before we make it permanent.

kevin (eng-runtime): Repro notes: run streaming SDK v0.9.4 with retry enabled, simulate a 504 on the finalize webhook, and cause a DB row lock to force deadlock. Observed behavior: finalize handler rolls back leaving token_delta=0. Suggested fix: make finalize idempotent primarily by session_id and let reconcile fallback to session_id when idempotency_key differs. I'll open a PR to change reconcile logic to check session_id fallback and to surface a clear audit trail for commits.

josh (support): Created internal tracking ticket TKT-5577 for customer communication + follow-up.

ana (billing): Done — provisioned 1200 provisional tokens (meta: credit_provisional=true). Will revert if engineering shows debit actually occurred. Please update when PR lands.

kevin (eng-runtime): Will push a quick patch to reconcile today and paste PR link here once ready.

josh (support): Thanks — I'll message the customer: credited 1200 provisional tokens, engineers investigating, ETA 24h.
